g.text: Each type of program against the systems native to it

text.style: fill: #59636e; font: 10.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Each instance counts in one type, whatever language its source was written in. A system’s answers are over all

text.style: fill: #59636e; font: 10.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: of the type’s instances. On each row, tddlog’s total time (teal) and the system’s over the instances the system

text.style: fill: #59636e; font: 10.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: is given and either answers: a run that does not answer (out of time or memory, failed, or a program the system

text.style: fill: #59636e; font: 10.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: cannot express) counts as its time limit, a time under 0.2 s as 0.2 s. The five best native systems by answers

text.style: fill: #59636e; font: 10.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: have a row each; the others share one, with the least of their totals and of their ratios to tddlog.
